types.description: TeSys D / Deca 4-pole contactor / 2 NO (1-2, 3-4) + 2 NC (R1-R2, R3-R4) power poles / integrated 1 NO (13-14) + 1 NC (21-22) aux / 230 V AC 50/60 Hz coil / AC-1 25 A

document.title: Schneider Electric Catalogue chapter B8 - Contactors (TeSys D/SK/K/GC/GY/GF), EN
document.pages: B8/12 selection row LC1D128pp (PDF p.12); a.c. coil table P7=230V 50/60Hz (PDF p.12); B8/79 scheme group 'LC1D098 to D258' (PDF p.79, rendered/inspected)

modelingNotes: Identity: base radical LC1D128 + a.c. coil code P7. Manufacturer spelling is unhyphenated LC1D128P7; source hyphens are presentation separators. Non-reversing, screw-clamp terminals, open style.

Power poles verified from B8/79 scheme (image 127269.eps, group 'LC1D098 to D258', which contains LC1D128), rendered and visually inspected: NO poles 1/2 and 3/4; NC poles R1/R2 and R3/R4. Independently corroborated by FAQ FA119547.

Integrated auxiliary contacts are the contactor's own row (selection table B8/12: '2 2 1 1'): 1 NO = 13/14, 1 NC = 21/22. Verified in the same scheme. The neighbouring LC1D40008..D80008 scheme shows identical power poles but NO auxiliary (table '– –'), so the auxiliary was not transferred from a neighbour.

Coil A1/A2, P7 = 230 V a.c. 50/60 Hz. Per B8/12, within the a.c. range only LC1D115 and D150 coils have a built-in suppression device as standard; LC1D128 P7 has NO built-in suppressor and, as an a.c. coil, no polarity.

Power poles: AC-1, Ue <= 440 V, Ie 25 A (theta <= 60 C), Ith 20 A. These are capabilities across AC and DC utilisation categories and a voltage range, so no nominal_voltage/voltage_type scalar is assigned to the poles; <=440 V is a ceiling, not an assigned supply. Auxiliary contacts are application-dependent control contacts with no scalar rating asserted.

All poles and auxiliaries are switched contacts and the coil is a separate winding: there are no permanent internal net joins. Coil-to-contact actuation (internal_relations) is mechanical/functional, not electrical continuity.
No dedicated PE terminal on the device; panel/rail earthing is external. Front/side add-on auxiliary blocks, timer/interface and suppressor modules are separately ordered and not part of this type.

connectionCoverage.notes: Full factory electrical terminal set inventoried and verified against the manufacturer scheme B8/79: 2 NO + 2 NC power poles (1/2, 3/4, R1/R2, R3/R4), integrated 1 NO (13/14) + 1 NC (21/22) auxiliary, and coil A1/A2. No PE terminal exists on the device; external bonding and separately ordered add-on modules are out of scope.
